---
title: "Does the 714 mm flat plate design meet the 50 g mass budget under the library mass model?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 300.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 60.2      # s the probe actually used

mass_budget_g = 50.0
target_span = 0.714
stall_angle = 5.75

sink_lib, opt_lib = optimize_geometry_library(get_airplane_plate, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=target_span)
total_mass_lib_g = opt_lib.m_total * 1000
ballast_mass_lib_g = opt_lib.mass_ballast * 1000
airframe_mass_lib_g = total_mass_lib_g - ballast_mass_lib_g
mass_excess_lib_g = total_mass_lib_g - mass_budget_g

sink_hand, opt_hand = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane_plate, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=target_span)
total_mass_hand_g = opt_hand.m_total * 1000
ballast_mass_hand_g = opt_hand.mass_ballast * 1000
airframe_mass_hand_g = total_mass_hand_g - ballast_mass_hand_g
delta_mass_g = total_mass_lib_g - total_mass_hand_g

assert total_mass_lib_g > mass_budget_g
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"No, {total_mass_lib_g:.1f} g"`]{.hero-value}
[all-up mass under library mass model]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** No. Under the [library mass model](2026-09-30-01-does-replacing-hand-rolled-mass-geometry-with-wing-area-and-fuselage-v.qmd), the optimized [714 mm planform](2026-09-29-09-does-the-714-mm-flat-plate-design-meet-the-50-g-mass-budget.qmd) reaches an all-up mass of [`{python} f"{total_mass_lib_g:.1f} g"`]{.key}, exceeding the [`{python} f"{mass_budget_g:.0f} g"`]{.key} [budget](../02-wings-at-rear/2026-09-29-01-does-it-meet-the-50-g-mass-budget-with-ballast-fitted.qmd) by [`{python} f"{mass_excess_lib_g:.1f} g"`]{.key}. Although axial frustum integration saves [`{python} f"{abs(delta_mass_g):.2f} g"`]{.key} of fuselage foam relative to the hand-rolled model, the 714 mm wing already required zero trim ballast ([`{python} f"{ballast_mass_lib_g:.1f} g"`]{.key}). Unlike the [300 mm wing](2026-09-29-08-does-the-300-mm-flat-plate-design-meet-the-50-g-mass-budget.qmd), where aft CG shift eliminated ballast to meet the budget, the 714 mm mass is purely structural foam and cannot be brought below the budget (@tbl-714-mass).

```{python}
#| label: tbl-714-mass
#| tbl-cap: "Mass comparison of the 714 mm flat plate design between hand-rolled and library models."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

header = ["Component", "Hand-rolled", "Library", "Delta"]
rows = [
    ("Airframe", f"{airframe_mass_hand_g:.2f} g", f"{airframe_mass_lib_g:.2f} g", f"{airframe_mass_lib_g - airframe_mass_hand_g:.2f} g"),
    ("Ballast", f"{ballast_mass_hand_g:.2f} g", f"{ballast_mass_lib_g:.2f} g", f"{ballast_mass_lib_g - ballast_mass_hand_g:.2f} g"),
    ("Total mass", f"{total_mass_hand_g:.2f} g", f"{total_mass_lib_g:.2f} g", f"{delta_mass_g:.2f} g"),
    ("Budget excess", f"{total_mass_hand_g - mass_budget_g:.2f} g", f"{mass_excess_lib_g:.2f} g", f"{delta_mass_g:.2f} g"),
]
md_table(header, rows)
```
